data.name: Nawhan
data.gender_notes: Nawhan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-h', meaning 'to give' or 'to grant'. In Islamic tradition, Nawhan refers to a person who is given divine blessings and favors. This name is often given to children who are believed to be particularly blessed or favored. The name Nawhan carries the meaning “Gift, blessing, grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawhan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's endless blessings and favors upon us.
data.etymology: Nawhan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, blessing, grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawhan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نوحان
in_arabic.meaning: معنى هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى ويعني الناصر و الخازن
